newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU still mulling Guinness/Grand Met deal.
newsitem.headline: EU still mulling Guinness/Grand Met deal.

text.p: The European Commmission is still considering whether to start a full probe into the proposed merger of drinks company Guinness Plc and Grand Metropolitan Plc, EU Competition chief Karel Van Miert said on Tuesday.

Van Miert said the deal was very complex because of the number of products and countries concerned. The Commission must decide by the end of the week whether to clear the deal or start an in-depth investigation which could last another four months.
"The problem is to define the relevant geographical and product markets," Van Miert told reporters after speaking to a European Parliament committee.
"We will see whether we need to go into a second phase (of proceedings)."

Van Miert said he had met the companies and competitors and that the two partners had provided the EU with information up to the end of last week. He said the whisky market, for example, was difficult to assess.
